description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableJsonifiableAdaptable' which implements the 'JsonifiableAdaptable' interface. The class provides methods to create instances from Adaptable objects or JSON objects, and to convert these objects back into JSON format. It manages JSON fields related to headers, topic paths, and payloads, and includes standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonifiableAdaptable
classes.description: An immutable implementation of JsonifiableAdaptable, wrapping an Adaptable object and providing JSON serialization and deserialization functionalities.
